query: Yolcunun kayıp bagajı bulundu. Adrese teslim için ondan ücret alacak mıyız, bir de takip numarasını yolcuya nasıl iletmem gerekiyordu?
why: Turkish query on a Turkish macro; the delivery-charge and SMS detail exist nowhere else, so it must hit even with a weak embedder.

query: Yolcu uçuşa yetişememiş ama sebep bizim 4 saatlik gecikmemiz. Bunu no-show olarak mı işleyeceğim, yoksa başka bir makroya mı geçmem lazım?
why: Baseline in-language retrieval of the no-show macro's own exception clause, which no other document states.

query: Uçuşu biz iptal ettik, yolcuyu aynı gün akşam seferine aldım. PNR'a hangi notu düşmem gerekiyor ve yolcuya bilgilendirme hangi kanaldan gidiyor?
why: The PNR remark and notification channel are Turkish-only procedural detail; a clean in-language baseline.

query: Bağlantısını kaçıran yolcuyla görüşürken okuyacağım hazır bir metin var mıydı, görüşmede adımları hangi sırayla uygulamam gerekiyor?
why: The read-out script and step order live only in the Turkish misconnect macro, not in the English SOP it points to.

query: Yolcu aktarmasını kaçırdı, bir sonraki sefer için 4 saat bekleyecek. Şu an yürürlükte olan kurala göre kendisine kaç euroluk yemek fişi vermem gerekiyor?
why: The corpus's hardest measured case: a Turkish question whose only correct source is the current English SOP, with the superseded version sitting there as a same-shape decoy.

query: Uçak dolu olduğu için yolcuyu uçuramadık, Avrupa içi bir sefer ve varışa yaklaşık 3 saat gecikmeyle ulaşacak. Kendisine ne kadar tazminat ödüyoruz?
why: Turkish paraphrase of a compensation tier that exists only in the English denied-boarding SOP.

query: Bizim gecikmemiz yüzünden yolcu ortak havayolunun devam uçuşuna yetişemedi. O bacağın kuponu sistemde düşer mi, yolcu uçuşa gelmemiş mi sayılacak?
why: The coupon-status consequence of the protection clause is only in the English agreement; the Turkish macro summarises the clause but never answers this.

query: Bilette bizim uçuş numaramız var ama uçağı ortak havayolu işletiyor. Yolcunun yemek ve otel hakkı kimin kuralına göre, kesilecek ceza kimin kuralına göre belirleniyor?
why: Turkish query for the care-versus-penalty carrier split that only the English codeshare conditions state.

query: Yolcu para iadesi istiyor ve ücret kuralı tablosunda hangi sütuna bakacağımı karıştırdım. Değişiklik sütununu mu iptal sütununu mu okuyacağım, tutarı akıldan söyleyebilir miyim?
why: Turkish query for an instruction held only in the English refund macro, and it is exactly the instruction the chunking demo makes the model break.

query: Tekerlekli sandalye isteyen yolcunun devam bacağı ortak havayolunun uçuşu. Talebi hangi bacaklara girmem gerekiyor ve kalkıştan kaç saat önce girilmiş olması lazım?
why: SSR placement and lead time are English-only; the Turkish side of the corpus never covers special assistance.

query: We cancelled the flight ourselves and the passenger is now waiting until the evening for the next one. At what point does a refreshment become due, at what point a meal, and when do we have to put them in a hotel?
why: English semantic retrieval of a duty-of-care table; proves the embedder is fine when query and document share a language.

query: One of our own staff got stuck overnight on a company trip when the aircraft went technical. How much can they claim back for meals during the delay and do they have to keep receipts?
why: English semantic retrieval of an employee expense ceiling, which is also the near-miss distractor for the passenger meal voucher question.

query: A colleague's trip is going to come to about four thousand euros all in. Who has to sign it off before anything gets booked?
why: Purely semantic English lookup of an approval band with no exact token in the query to fall back on.

query: Can I use the European penalty figures for a passenger flying to Bangkok, or is there a separate sheet I should be reading?
why: English semantic test that the route band, not just the fare family, selects the correct rule sheet.

query: Passenger wants to cancel a short-haul Europe ticket, CLASSIC fare, booking class K. How much is the cancellation penalty per passenger?
why: The fact the whole day turns on (EUR 90): fixed-size chunking separates the header row from the K row and the model confidently reads the change column instead.

query: Passenger is asking about H9 1487 IST-CDG after 25 October. What is the new departure time and which SCB bulletin does it come from?
why: Flight code and bulletin id are exact strings dense retrieval blurs across six near-identical bulletins but BM25 pins immediately.

query: Elimdeki SCB-2026-0902 bülteninde H9 2201 IST-FCO için 07:45 yazıyor. Bu saat hâlâ geçerli mi, yolcuya bunu mu söyleyeyim?
why: Exact bulletin id plus flight code where the right document is the later bulletin that withdraws the quoted time, not the one the agent named. SCB-2026-0902 is stamped Superseded and names its replacement, so the trap is checkable in the corpus.

query: H9 3310 IST-AMS için sistemde 15:40 kalkış görünüyor ama emin olamadım. Kış tarifesinde yolcuya hangi saati söylüyorum?
why: A second superseded pair, and unlike q17 the query names no bulletin id — only the flight code and the withdrawn 15:40, which both bulletins contain. Measured: BM25 over whole documents returns the superseded SCB-2026-0921 at rank 1 and the gold SCB-2026-0930 at rank 2, which is the single reason BM25's whole-document exact_token score is 0.750.

query: H9 1487 gecikti, CLASSIC K sınıfındaki yolcum CDG'de AU 88 bağlantısını kaçırıyor ve yeni uçuşa kadar 5 saat bekleyecek. Bu beklemede kendisine ne vermem gerekiyor, Aurora bacağı yeniden fiyatlandırılır mı, bir de yolcu bugünkü seferi hiç istemeyip kendi isteğiyle yarına geçmek isterse ondan ne kadar değişiklik ücreti alırım?
why: Needs three documents at once - care thresholds from the SOP, the no-repricing rule from the interline clause, and the CLASSIC K change amount from the short-haul sheet, which RULE 7 selects because the request is a voluntary change to a single coupon and the only Helios sector on the document is a European one - and no single file holds all three. The gold names the documents an amount may be quoted from: macro_tr_misconnect names both flight codes and states the no-repricing rule, macro_tr_rebook states it too and faq_en_general Q5 states it in English, but all three refuse to carry a figure and send the agent to the SOP and the fare sheet. Measured on whole documents: BM25 returns macro_tr_rebook at rank 1 and macro_tr_misconnect at rank 2, bge-m3 returns faq_en_general at rank 1, so this question scores zero while looking right.

query: H9 3310 went technical and my passenger will miss the Aurora Atlantic onward flight from Amsterdam to New York. They are CLASSIC class K on a through ticket and the next Aurora departure is nine hours later. What care do I arrange during the wait, does the Aurora coupon get repriced, and if they give up on the trip and cancel instead, what do I collect?
why: The same three-document shape on the long-haul band: RULE 7 sends a cancellation of the journey as a whole to the LONG-HAUL sheet, so quoting the short-haul K figure is a visible failure rather than a lucky hit.
